title: Subthreshold oscillations and spiking in hybrid neuron models with a dynamic threshold
summary: We investigate a class of two-dimensional hybrid non-autonomous periodically forced neuron models known as the Meng-Huguet-Rinzel neuron model, with a dynamic threshold and reset mechanism. We focus on the interplay between the continuous subthreshold dynamics and discrete spike-induced resets. The model consists of a linear voltage equation coupled with a threshold variable governed by a nonlinear function of the membrane potential (voltage), and incorporates periodic external forcing in the form of either pulse or rectified sinusoidal currents.
